name: Homepage
description: A dashboard for all your services, with live widgets.
compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS: "*"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/app/config
